profile.headline: Software Developer | Product Manager
profile.summary:
As a software engineer and technical product manager, I blend my deep understanding of object-oriented programming, database technologies, and user-centered design to develop impactful web and mobile applications. My journey extends beyond coding, as I navigate through product development, from concept to launch, ensuring that our solutions are not only technically robust but also market-ready and user-focused. My role is to connect the dots between technology capabilities and business goals, ensuring that our products resonate with users and stand out in the market.

I worked in the education sector prior to transitioning to computer programming. In my time working at both a lower socio-economic status public school and a private school, I gained an appreciation for importance of understanding technology. I knew I could help my students even more if I had a deeper understanding of both software and hardware structures. This was the cause of my decision to begin studying computer science and to receive my third bachelors degree in Application development. On top of my passion for education, I have found my passion for coding and problem solving. It's a new way of looking at the world.

Languages & Technologies:
- Python, C#, .NET Core, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3
- React.js, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Django, REST, Tailwind CSS
- Microsoft Azure, AWS
- GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Mural

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain web and mobile applications using .NET Core, C#, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
- Manage and execute CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for seamless feature deployments.
- Test and validate updates across multiple Kentico environments to ensure quality and stability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including the Ecology team, to resolve bugs and define new feature requirements.
- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying and implementing development and process enhancements.
- Support backend technical setup and troubleshooting for agency-wide all staff events, ensuring smooth operation and accessibility for all participants.
- Collaborate with the AI Ethics team to present policy and process frameworks, helping develop agency-wide guidelines for responsible and effective writing with AI.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · HTML5 · Azure DevOps Services · Jira · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Technical Product Manager
positions.description:
- Defined and communicated the product vision and strategy, aligning with business goals and client needs to develop a comprehensive product roadmap.
- Collaborated with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams to gather and document product requirements, prioritizing features based on business value and technical feasibility.
- Oversaw the product development lifecycle from concept to launch, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards while coordinating cross-functional teams using project management tools.
- Acted as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates on project status, gathering and analyzing client feedback, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and product alignment with their needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Project Management · Jira · Confluence · Backlog Management · Technology Roadmapping

positions.title: Software Developer | Product Manager
positions.description:
- Authored comprehensive onboarding documentation to streamline the integration process for new team members.
- Completed Azure Runbooks migrations within Microsoft Azure Services, optimizing cloud operations and improving system reliability.
- Successfully piloted an initiative to implement CI/CD processes by automating application deployments to on premise servers using Microsoft Azure Pipelines and Deployment groups, improving the reliability of deploying application updates to customers. 
- Conducted extensive research and developed detailed Git workflow documentation, standardizing development practices for the growing development team.
- Debugged and resolved critical errors in a .NET project, specifically issues related to non-binary files not included in .gitignore, enhancing project stability.
- Engaged with internal dashboard application users to identify bugs, and efficiently translated feedback into actionable Jira bug stories.
- Implemented advanced Blazor and C# code to augment and introduce new features in internal application, driven by user feedback, significantly boosting application performance and user satisfaction.
- Led a pilot project as a product manager from design to production, providing a medical organization with ESL labels and a web application for inventory management, showcasing strong project management skills and client-focused solutions.
- Cleaned client data from Excel spreadsheets and skillfully created a structured SQL database, enhancing internal usage efficiency. 
- Designed ESL labels utilizing data from client's inventory item master, demonstrating exceptional attention to detail and client-specific customization.
positions.insights: Skills: Organization Skills · Customer Experience · Written Communication · Product Requirements · Product Road Mapping · Program Management · Product Analysis · Product Presentation · Strategic Thinking · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · Jira · B2B Testing · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern (Capstone)
positions.description:
- Built a React-native app for Android/iOS mobile devices
- Used Android Studio, JavaScript, React, Node.js and Expo to run app
- Created member’s login and live chat with Rocket.Chat
- Deployed app on Google Play Store

Below explains the steps to run the app: 

The Mars Society app is built in React Native and uses Expo. To get started you will want to follow the instructions for setting up Expo that are well documented here: https://docs.expo.io/versions/latest/get-started/installation/?redirected Note the differences between running with iOS and Android. Both have apps available in their respective stores on your mobile device.

As the info in the link shows you, the first thing you need is Node.js – the link to downloading the latest version is here: https://nodejs.org/en/

Once you have Node.js installed, you can begin with Expo. In your command prompt navigate to the folder you want your project to be located in. Once there, the command for cloning the repo will be the usual “git clone” along with the link to the Mars Society App repo. git clone https://github.com/marssociety/MobileV1/tree/master

This is the command you want to run in order to download Expo:
npm install -g expo-cli

Dependencies: react-navigation react-native-screens expo-av npm install --save @expo/vector-icons

Now, to run the application you simply type this command: expo start

This will generate a QR code in both your web browser and in your command prompt. You can choose to either scan the code with your mobile device inside the Expo app you have downloaded from the beginning of the tutorial, or you can chose to run the project with an emulator. If you chose to use the emulator, make sure it is open and running before selecting the emulator option as an option.
